context: Native hybrid APK/iOS social-marketplace app shell where status icons overlapped header, zoom jitter occurred, sign-in looked like generic AI-SaaS slop, and perceived speed was lagging.
emotional_archetype: ARCHETYPE 5: LUXURY & ELECTRIC SOCIAL (Midnight Violet & Neon Bloom)

viewport_specs.target_devices: Android (360px–430px wide, e.g. Pixel 7, Galaxy S23) and iPhone (375px–430px, e.g. iPhone 14/15 Pro)

topbar.strategy: Apply padding-top with env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px) plus an intentional Android status clearance minimum (min 28px–36px in APK webview).
topbar.avoidance: Never use pure transparent header; prevent status bar battery/time/wifi indicators from colliding with logo and icon actions.

bottom_dock.strategy: Floating pill dock with safe-bottom spacer and backdrop blur so content never overlaps and Android navigation bar/gesture pill has breathing space.
bottom_dock.classes: fixed inset-x-3 bottom-[max(env(safe-area-inset-bottom),12px)] z-40 mx-auto max-w-md pb-[env(safe-area-inset-bottom)]
bottom_dock.dock_container: flex h-[62px] items-center justify-around rounded-[32px] bg-[#170E3B]/90 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/15 shadow-[0_16px_36px_rgba(5,2,24,0.65)] px-2

hierarchy.price_tag: text-[11.5px] font-extrabold text-[#24126A] bg-white rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5

anti_ai_slop_principles: Remove generic centered corporate SaaS badges ('Secure creator access' pills with shield icons).
Eliminate bland 48px standard enterprise forms with generic white cards.
Make sign-in feel like an ultra-slick native social app: TikTok, BeReal, or Instagram-grade dark glass presentation.
Display an editorial creator avatar reel or dynamic ambient backdrop that connects directly to the talent marketplace.
Group credentials into an iOS/Android compact grouped input container with integrated 1px divider, subtle focus rings, and high contrast typography.

compact_layout_structure.top_bar: Compact header with rounded circular back button, small brand mark, and status-bar offset.
compact_layout_structure.hero_block: Punchy 2-line title ('Step into HireAvatar' / 'Sign in to direct, hire, or present') with compact spacing (mb-4 instead of massive mb-9).
compact_layout_structure.primary_action: High-contrast one-tap Google auth button styled natively with sharp tactile micro-press.
compact_layout_structure.divider: Subtle 1px line with 'or continue with email' at 10px bold uppercase tracking.
compact_layout_structure.grouped_fields: Stacked input pill with email on top and password below, rounded-2xl border border-white/15 bg-white/[0.06] backdrop-blur-md.
compact_layout_structure.cta_button: Gradient pill (from #FF4D8D via #B35CFF to #7C5CFF) with spring micro-interaction and tactile active:scale-95.
compact_layout_structure.toggle_footer: Compact footer switcher with high-contrast link for switching between Sign In and Sign Up.

discovery_grid_specs.viewport_fit: Exact 2-column grid on 360px–430px mobile screens without edge overflow or horizontal scroll jitter.
discovery_grid_specs.grid_classes: grid grid-cols-2 gap-2.5 sm:gap-3.5 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4

card_structure.live_indicator: 8px emerald dot with subtle pulse for online presenters
card_structure.text_truncation: Strict truncate on creator name and category to guarantee no multi-line wrapping breaks card heights

perceived_performance_strategy.problem: App felt dead slow during navigation, tab switching, and initial load.
solutions: Immediate Skeleton Shimmer: Replace centered spinning Loader2 wheels with animated 2-column skeleton creator cards that match the layout 1:1 instantly.
Optimistic UI on likes and saves: toggle state locally immediately before waiting for API network acknowledgment.
Image progressive loading: add blurred micro-color placeholder behind cards before full resolution loads.
Hardware-accelerated animations: use transform and opacity only (will-change-transform, translate3d). Never animate height or margin.
Memory efficient list rendering: limit initial DOM nodes and cache API responses in React state.

image_urls.description: 3D Stylized digital creator avatar with blue cap, perfect for mobile showcase badge or sample card
Artistic creator avatar with purple hoodie and vibrant expression
Female avatar with lilac hair and glasses, representing vibrant creator styles
Real presenter in podcasting studio with ring light and camera microphone
Video presenter wearing headphones in broadcast studio

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. In /app/frontend/public/index.html, enforce strict mobile viewport parameters to eliminate unwanted pinch-zoom/zoom jitter on input focus: set content='width=device-width, initial-scale=1, maximum-scale=1, user-scalable=no, viewport-fit=cover'.
2. In /app/frontend/src/index.css, add html, body { touch-action: pan-x pan-y; overflow-x: hidden; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; } to eliminate horizontal drift and zooming anomalies.

3. In /app/frontend/src/components/layout/AppShell.jsx, overhaul TopBar to include pt-[max(env(safe-area-inset-top),28px)] and safe top padding so Android/iOS status icons (time, battery, signal) never clip the logo, back button, or action pills. Maintain solid glass blur bg-[#170E3B]/95 instead of transparent overlay.

4. Overhaul BottomNav in AppShell to float above the home indicator using pb-[env(safe-area-inset-bottom,12px)] and give <main> pb-[calc(88px+env(safe-area-inset-bottom,16px))] so cards at the bottom are never hidden behind the navigation dock.

5. In /app/frontend/src/components/auth/NativeAuthScreen.jsx, strip out AI-slop corporate badges ('Secure creator access', generic shields, huge redundant copy). Replace with an Instagram/TikTok style compact dark-glass container, unified input group, crisp social button, and high-energy typography.

6. In /app/frontend/src/pages/Discover.jsx, replace blank screen / single spinner with an immediate 2-column skeleton grid (6 skeleton cards) during fetch states. Ensure grid-cols-2 has gap-2.5 on mobile so two cards fit seamlessly within 360px–430px widths without clipping or horizontal scrolling.
7. In /app/frontend/src/components/CreatorCard.jsx, enforce aspect-[3/4.2], rounded-[20px], and tight typography so titles and pricing badges stay legible and balanced on compact Android screens.
8. Retain all data-testid attributes faithfully for automated regression test suites.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.viewport_integrity: Prevent horizontal scrolling at all costs with w-full max-w-full overflow-x-hidden on the mobile shell.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.mobile_touch: Ensure all interactive tap targets are at least 44x44px and have subtle active:scale-95 feedback without sticky hover states.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.status_bar_safety: Always use env(safe-area-inset-top) with a fallback (28px minimum on Android APK) for any sticky or fixed top navigation.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.skeleton_previews: Never present a blank screen or plain spinner when content is loading; provide layout-mirroring skeletons for immediate perceived responsiveness.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.color_purity: Preserve the rich midnight violet and electric pink theme without introducing generic SaaS blues or muddy gradients.
